front: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a à voir dans la région ?
pronunciation: [kehs-keel yah ah VWAHR dahn lah ray-ZHYOHN]
back: What is there to see in the area?
context: A good question for the tourist office ('l'office de tourisme').

front: Le musée est fermé le mardi.
pronunciation: [luh mü-ZAY eh fehr-MAY luh mar-DEE]
back: The museum is closed on Tuesdays.
context: Many national museums close on Tuesday (the Louvre) or Monday (the Musée d'Orsay).

front: Combien coûte l'entrée ?
pronunciation: [kohm-byan koot lahn-TRAY]
back: How much is admission?
context: 'L'entrée' = admission (and also the entrance, and the starter in a meal).

front: L'entrée est gratuite pour les moins de vingt-six ans.
pronunciation: [lahn-tray eh grah-TWEET poor lay mwan duh vant-SEE ZAHN]
back: Entry is free for under-26s.
context: EU residents under 26 get free access to French national museums.

front: Il y a une visite guidée en anglais ?
pronunciation: [eel yah ün vee-zeet ghee-DAY ahn nahn-GLEH]
back: Is there a guided tour in English?
context: 'Un audioguide' is often available too.

front: On a fait la queue pendant une heure pour voir la Joconde.
pronunciation: [ohn nah feh lah KUH pahn-dahn tün UHR poor vwahr lah zhoh-KOHND]
back: We queued for an hour to see the Mona Lisa.
context: 'Faire la queue' = to stand in line. 'La Joconde' = the Mona Lisa.

front: Il est conseillé de réserver les billets à l'avance.
pronunciation: [ee leh kohn-seh-YAY duh ray-zehr-vay lay bee-YEH ah lah-VAHNS]
back: Booking tickets in advance is recommended.
context: 'Il est conseillé de' + infinitive = it's advisable to.

front: La tour Eiffel a été construite pour l'Exposition universelle de 1889.
pronunciation: [lah toor eh-FEL ah ay-tay kohns-TRWEET poor lek-spoh-zee-syohn ü-nee-vehr-SEL duh meelweet sahn kah-truh-van-NUHF]
back: The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1889 World's Fair.
context: Passive voice in the past. It was meant to be temporary!

front: Le château de Versailles se trouve à vingt kilomètres de Paris.
pronunciation: [luh shah-toh duh vehr-SAHY suh troov ah van kee-loh-MEH-truh duh pah-REE]
back: The Palace of Versailles is 20 km from Paris.
context: 'Se trouver' = to be located.

front: Les châteaux de la Loire valent vraiment le détour.
pronunciation: [lay shah-TOH duh lah LWAHR vahl vreh-mahn luh day-TOOR]
back: The Loire Valley châteaux are really worth the detour.
context: 'Valoir le détour' / 'valoir le coup' = to be worth it.

front: Le Mont-Saint-Michel est entouré par la mer à marée haute.
pronunciation: [luh mohn san mee-SHEL eh tahn-too-RAY par lah MEHR ah mah-ray OHT]
back: Mont-Saint-Michel is surrounded by the sea at high tide.
context: 'Marée haute / basse' = high / low tide.

front: On peut monter en haut de la tour ?
pronunciation: [ohn puh mohn-tay ahn OH duh lah TOOR]
back: Can we go up to the top of the tower?
context: 'En haut de' = at the top of.

front: La vue d'en haut est à couper le souffle.
pronunciation: [lah vü dahn OH eh tah koo-pay luh SOO-fluh]
back: The view from the top is breathtaking.
context: 'À couper le souffle' = breathtaking.

front: C'est un quartier très animé le soir.
pronunciation: [seh tan kar-tyay treh zah-nee-MAY luh SWAHR]
back: It's a very lively neighborhood in the evening.
context: 'Animé' = lively, busy.

front: Ce village a gardé tout son charme d'autrefois.
pronunciation: [suh vee-LAHZH ah gar-DAY too sohn sharm doh-truh-FWAH]
back: This village has kept all its old-time charm.
context: 'D'autrefois' = of the past.

front: La cathédrale date du treizième siècle.
pronunciation: [lah kah-tay-DRAL daht dü treh-zyem SYEH-kluh]
back: The cathedral dates from the 13th century.
context: 'Dater de' = to date from. Centuries use ordinal numbers.

front: Il est interdit de prendre des photos avec flash.
pronunciation: [ee leh tan-tehr-DEE duh prahn-druh day foh-TOH ah-vek FLASH]
back: Flash photography is forbidden.
context: 'Il est interdit de' + infinitive.

front: On s'est perdus dans les petites rues du vieux Lyon.
pronunciation: [ohn seh pehr-DÜ dahn lay puh-teet RÜ dü vyuh lee-OHN]
back: We got lost in the little streets of old Lyon.
context: With 'on' = nous, the participle often agrees (perdus).

front: Je vous conseille de visiter la ville à pied.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo kohn-SAY duh vee-zee-tay lah veel ah PYAY]
back: I advise you to visit the town on foot.
context: 'Conseiller à quelqu'un de' + infinitive.

front: Le marché de Noël de Strasbourg est très célèbre.
pronunciation: [luh mar-shay duh noh-EL duh straz-BOOR eh treh say-LEH-bruh]
back: Strasbourg's Christmas market is very famous.
context: One of the oldest Christmas markets in Europe.

front: On a fait une balade en bateau sur la Seine.
pronunciation: [ohn nah feh tün bah-lahd ahn bah-TOH sür lah SEN]
back: We took a boat trip on the Seine.
context: 'Les bateaux-mouches' are the famous Paris tour boats.

front: La plage est bondée en plein été.
pronunciation: [lah plahzh eh bohn-DAY ahn plan nay-TAY]
back: The beach is packed in midsummer.
context: 'Bondé' = packed. 'En plein été' = in the height of summer.

front: J'ai acheté quelques souvenirs pour ma famille.
pronunciation: [zhay ahsh-TAY kel-kuh soov-NEER poor mah fah-MEE]
back: I bought a few souvenirs for my family.
context: 'Un souvenir' = a souvenir (and also a memory).

front: Le guide nous a raconté l'histoire du château.
pronunciation: [luh GHEED noo zah rah-kohn-TAY lees-twahr dü shah-TOH]
back: The guide told us the history of the castle.
context: 'Raconter' = to tell (a story).

front: Cette église est classée au patrimoine mondial de l'Unesco.
pronunciation: [set ay-GLEEZ eh klah-SAY oh pah-tree-mwahn mohn-DYAL duh lü-nes-KOH]
back: This church is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
context: 'Le patrimoine' = heritage.

front: Les Journées du patrimoine ont lieu en septembre.
pronunciation: [lay zhoor-nay dü pah-tree-MWAHN ohn lyuh ahn sep-TAHM-bruh]
back: Heritage Days take place in September.
context: Many normally closed buildings open to the public for free.

front: On a loué des vélos pour faire le tour de l'île.
pronunciation: [ohn nah loo-AY day vay-LOH poor fehr luh toor duh LEEL]
back: We rented bikes to go around the island.
context: 'Faire le tour de' = to go around.

front: Le coucher de soleil sur la baie était inoubliable.
pronunciation: [luh koo-shay duh soh-LAY sür lah BEH ay-teh tee-noo-blee-YAH-bluh]
back: The sunset over the bay was unforgettable.
context: 'Inoubliable' = unforgettable.

front: Ce restaurant est un vrai piège à touristes.
pronunciation: [suh res-toh-RAHN eh tan vreh pyezh ah too-REEST]
back: This restaurant is a real tourist trap.
context: 'Un piège à touristes' = tourist trap.

front: Tu connais un endroit moins touristique ?
pronunciation: [tü koh-neh an nahn-drwah mwan too-rees-TEEK]
back: Do you know a less touristy place?
context: 'Un endroit' = a place.

front: On a passé la journée au bord du lac d'Annecy.
pronunciation: [ohn nah pah-say lah zhoor-nay oh bor dü lak dan-SEE]
back: We spent the day by Lake Annecy.
context: 'Au bord de' = by, on the edge of.

front: Les gorges du Verdon sont un paradis pour les randonneurs.
pronunciation: [lay gorzh dü vehr-DOHN sohn tan pah-rah-DEE poor lay rahn-doh-NUHR]
back: The Verdon Gorge is a paradise for hikers.
context: 'Un randonneur' = a hiker.

front: J'ai pris plein de photos.
pronunciation: [zhay pree plan duh foh-TOH]
back: I took loads of photos.
context: 'Plein de' = lots of (informal).

front: Il faut absolument goûter les spécialités locales.
pronunciation: [eel foh tab-soh-lü-MAHN goo-tay lay spay-syah-lee-tay loh-KAL]
back: You absolutely have to try the local specialties.
context: 'Goûter' = to taste, try (food).

front: Ce voyage restera gravé dans ma mémoire.
pronunciation: [suh vwah-YAHZH res-tuh-RAH grah-VAY dahn mah may-MWAHR]
back: This trip will stay engraved in my memory.
context: Futur simple: restera. 'Gravé' = engraved.
